
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/liuyangjava/p/19390194" title="发布于 2025-12-24 09:28">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">SpringBoot+MyBatis实现数据库字段加密</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>今天分享一篇基于SpringBoot+MyBatis来实现数据库字段加密的操作，喜欢的朋友可以借鉴</p>
<p><strong>大致的实现流程</strong></p>
<p>业务层--&gt;系统拦截器--&gt;数据库--&gt;系统拦截器--&gt;返回结果</p>
<p><strong>加密注解设计</strong></p>
<p>把需要加密的字段通过我们自定义的加密注解进行标识，所以我们需要先自定义一段加密注解的代码</p>
<pre class="language-java highlighter-hljs"><code>@Target(ElementType.FIELD)
@Retention(RetentionPolicy.RUNTIME)
public&nbsp;@interface&nbsp;Encrypt {
}</code></pre>
<p><strong>实体类</strong></p>
<p>在实体类上使用注解标记需要加密字段</p>
<pre class="language-java highlighter-hljs"><code>@Data
public&nbsp;class&nbsp;User&nbsp;{
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;private&nbsp;Long id;
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;private&nbsp;String username;
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;@Encrypt
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;private&nbsp;String password;
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;@Encrypt
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;private&nbsp;String email;
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;@Encrypt
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;private&nbsp;String phone;
}</code></pre>
<p><strong>加密工具类</strong></p>
<p>基于AES加密算法实现对字段名的加密，大家可以选择其他的加密算法</p>
<pre class="language-java highlighter-hljs"><code>public&nbsp;class&nbsp;EncryptionUtil&nbsp;{
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;privatestaticfinal&nbsp;String ALGORITHM =&nbsp;"AES";
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;privatestaticfinal&nbsp;String TRANSFORMATION =&nbsp;"AES/ECB/PKCS5Padding";
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;// AES加密
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;public&nbsp;static&nbsp;String&nbsp;encrypt(String plainText, String key)&nbsp;{
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;try&nbsp;{
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; SecretKeySpec secretKey =&nbsp;new&nbsp;SecretKeySpec(key.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8), ALGORITHM);
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; Cipher cipher = Cipher.getInstance(TRANSFORMATION);
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; cipher.init(Cipher.ENCRYPT_MODE, secretKey);
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;byte[] encryptedBytes = cipher.doFinal(plainText.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;return&nbsp;Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString(encryptedBytes);
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; }&nbsp;catch&nbsp;(Exception e) {
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;thrownew&nbsp;RuntimeException("加密失败", e);
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; }
&nbsp; &nbsp; }
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;// AES解密
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;public&nbsp;static&nbsp;String&nbsp;decrypt(String cipherText, String key)&nbsp;{
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;try&nbsp;{
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; SecretKeySpec secretKey =&nbsp;new&nbsp;SecretKeySpec(key.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8), ALGORITHM);
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; Cipher cipher = Cipher.getInstance(TRANSFORMATION);
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; cipher.init(Cipher.DECRYPT_MODE, secretKey);
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;byte[] decryptedBytes = cipher.doFinal(Base64.getDecoder().decode(cipherText));
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;returnnew&nbsp;String(decryptedBytes, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; }&nbsp;catch&nbsp;(Exception e) {
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;thrownew&nbsp;RuntimeException("解密失败", e);
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; }
&nbsp; &nbsp; }
}</code></pre>
<p><strong>系统拦截器设计</strong></p>
<p>通过拦截实现自动加密和自动解密</p>
<pre class="language-java highlighter-hljs"><code>// 加密拦截器
@Intercepts({
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;@Signature(type = Executor.class,&nbsp;method&nbsp;=&nbsp;"update", args = {MappedStatement.class,&nbsp;Object.class})
})
@Component
public&nbsp;class&nbsp;FieldEncryptionInterceptor&nbsp;implements&nbsp;Interceptor&nbsp;{
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;@Value("${encryption.key:mySecretKey12345}")
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;private&nbsp;String encryptionKey;
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;@Override
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;public&nbsp;Object&nbsp;intercept(Invocation invocation)&nbsp;throws&nbsp;Throwable&nbsp;{
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; Object[] args = invocation.getArgs();
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; MappedStatement mappedStatement = (MappedStatement) args[0];
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; Object parameter = args[1];
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;// 获取SQL命令类型
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; String sqlCommandType = mappedStatement.getSqlCommandType().toString();
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;// 对INSERT和UPDATE操作进行加密处理
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;if&nbsp;("INSERT".equals(sqlCommandType) ||&nbsp;"UPDATE".equals(sqlCommandType)) {
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; encryptFields(parameter);
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; }
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;return&nbsp;invocation.proceed();
&nbsp; &nbsp; }
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;// 解密拦截器
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;@Intercepts({
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;@Signature(type = ResultSetHandler.class,&nbsp;method&nbsp;=&nbsp;"handleResultSets", args = {Statement.class})
&nbsp; &nbsp; })
&nbsp; &nbsp; @Component
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;public&nbsp;class&nbsp;FieldDecryptionInterceptor&nbsp;implements&nbsp;Interceptor&nbsp;{
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;@Value("${encryption.key:mySecretKey12345}")
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;private&nbsp;String encryptionKey;
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;@Override
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;public&nbsp;Object&nbsp;intercept(Invocation invocation)&nbsp;throws&nbsp;Throwable&nbsp;{
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;// 执行原始方法
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; Object result = invocation.proceed();
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;// 对查询结果进行解密处理
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;if&nbsp;(result&nbsp;instanceof&nbsp;List) {
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; List&lt;?&gt; list = (List&lt;?&gt;) result;
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;for&nbsp;(Object item : list) {
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; decryptFields(item);
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; }
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; }&nbsp;else&nbsp;{
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; decryptFields(result);
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; }
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;return&nbsp;result;
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; }
&nbsp; &nbsp; }
}</code></pre>
<p><strong>测试场景</strong></p>
<p>用户信息保护：在用户注册时，自动加密用户的密码、邮箱、手机号等敏感信息，即使数据库泄露也不会造成用户隐私泄露</p>
<p>金融数据保护：对用户的银行卡号、交易记录等金融数据进行加密存储，满足金融行业的合规要求</p>
<p>医疗医保数据保护：对患者的病历、诊断结果等医疗隐私数据进行加密，保护患者隐私</p>
<p>企业数据保护：对企业内部的商业机密、客户资料等重要数据进行加密保护</p>
<p><strong>注意事项</strong></p>
<p>虽然字段级加密功能强大，但在生产环境中使用时必须注意安全性：</p>
<p>密钥管理：不要在代码中硬编码密钥，应使用专业的密钥管理系统</p>
<p>算法选择：使用经过验证的加密算法，如AES-256</p>
<p>性能优化：合理选择需要加密的字段，避免对所有字段都进行加密</p>
<p>审计日志：记录所有加密解密操作，便于安全审计</p>
<p>定期轮换：定期更换加密密钥，降低密钥泄露风险</p>
</div>
